note: `schema_type!` on a SeaORM model now reports a malformed relation attribute value that must be an identifier (`#[sea_orm(relation_enum = "...")]`, `from = "..."`, or the target entity's `from` reached through `via_rel`), e.g. `from = "author id"`, as a compile error naming the field and value on the `schema_type!` source type, instead of crashing the macro with an opaque `syn::Ident::new` panic.
